# A stack returned home into a tabs node inside a split never settles

## Context

I found this while building #19583's witness. I ran it headless at `dev` `f1fbfe5c08` on FiveBeat's ordinary stage (viewport 1280×800, screen 1920×1080), driving `NativeGestureDriver#executeStackReturnStep`, the executor FiveBeat scene 4 runs in CI:

| Vessel | Home tabs node | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `metrics` alone | `right-top-tabs`, in a split with `right-bottom-tabs` | hangs, every run (≥ 6) |
| `commits` alone | `scale-tabs`, in a split with `heavy-tabs` | hangs, every run (≥ 4) |
| `metrics` + `queues` | `right-top-tabs`, split intact | hangs (1/1) |
| `metrics` + `commits` (scene 4's staging) | `right-top-tabs`; the `commits` tear-out collapsed `right-bottom-tabs` | settles in 0.6 s, every run |

A hang has these symptoms:
- The pane is adopted into main's document.
- `lastCrossWindowTransfer.phases` stops at `["documents-adopted"]`.
- The Neural Link call that drives the gesture times out at 10 s.
- The emptied vessel stays open, and `TourController#getCueLog` reports main's refresh `pending`.

Main then stays frozen. A later `setActiveItem` commit lands in the document and calls `projectDockZoneDocument`, but no `refreshDockWorkspace` starts within 3 s.

## The Problem

The mouseup commits `transferNode`. `VesselWorkspace#commitCrossWindowTransfer` awaits main's `refreshPromise` before it records `projections-settled` (`apps/workstation/view/VesselWorkspace.mjs:650`), so the close never comes. Every later main projection chains onto that promise (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2295`), so main's dock stops rendering.

The predicate is the home node's place in a split, not the vessel's item count. Two earlier readings of the stall, Mnemosyne's single-item note and my corroboration on #19583, were proxies. FiveBeat's staging never meets the predicate.

## The Architectural Reality

- `transferNode` admits the stable-topology path: `VesselWorkspace#getRefreshOptions` sets `retainTopology`, then `Reconciler.reconcileProjection` calls `reconcileStableTopology`.
- `reconcileStableTopology` writes `flex` and `wrapperStyle` with `setSilent` on every retained node whose projection carries `flex` (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/Reconciler.mjs:276-281`). A silent write leaves `needsVdomUpdate: true` and schedules no flight (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1318-1319`).
- The stable branch of `reconcileProjection` awaits `commitAncestors` and then `commitBars` (`Reconciler.mjs:494-502`), before the host commit that would publish those writes (`:503-505`).
- A committed bar's `promiseUpdate()` goes through `mergeIntoParentUpdate` (`VdomLifecycle.mjs:955`). It finds an ancestor flagged, registers as merged, and waits for that ancestor's update. Only the host commit after the await starts that update, so neither side moves.
- Measured with temporary trace markers, since reverted: the hanging refresh stops at the `commitBars` await. At the call and again 3 s later, the target bar, its tab container and the split container above it all hold `needsVdomUpdate: true`, and none is updating. The flags' writer is `Reconciler.mjs:277`. In the settling case, the bar's ancestors hold no flag.
- The awaited bar commit publishes silent bar-membership changes. It existed as `materializedBars`; #18025 (`2f8fc79792`) renamed it `commitBars` and widened it to both sides of a cross-bar move. `commitAncestors` serves same-window native reparenting. Either one hangs under a flex-bearing retained ancestor.
- Design authority: this is a hang that contradicts the surfaces' own JSDoc:
  - `VdomLifecycle#promiseUpdate`: "settles once that render has landed in the DOM";
  - `executeStackReturnStep`: it "waits through atomic `transferNode`, main projection, native close request, and physical topology exit".
  - The Dock guide also lists stack return among the "four roads home" (`learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsWindows.md:85`).

## The Fix

In `Reconciler.mjs`:
- `reconcileStableTopology` returns its `flex` writes as `geometry` instead of applying them in mid-scan.
- `reconcileProjection` applies them silently right before its depth `-1` host commit, which publishes them in the same flight as today.

This adds no flight, and no descendant commit merges into an ancestor update that nothing has scheduled. `width` and `height` stay as they are: a non-silent `set` starts its own flight, which a descendant awaits through `isParentUpdating`, not through a merge.

Rejected alternatives:
- Flushing the written ancestors before the bars adds flights to every stable projection.
- A non-silent `flex` costs one flight per split child on every splitter drag.
- Changing `mergeIntoParentUpdate` changes engine-wide semantics for every silent write.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Unit test with real in-process VDom flights: a `retainTopology` projection that adds a tab to a tabs node inside a split settles, and the new header button renders. Without the fix, the test hangs.
- [x] E2E: `executeStackReturnStep` brings a single-item vessel home into a split-held tabs node (`metrics` → `right-top-tabs`, `commits` → `scale-tabs`). Each return passes the four phases in order, the emptied vessel closes, and the pane is in its home node.
- [x] E2E: the same holds for a two-item vessel whose home node stays in its split (`metrics` + `queues`).
- [x] FiveBeat scene 4 and the dock unit suites stay green.

The evidence is in #19595, merged as `6188a7b049` with Emmy's approval:
- `DockStableSplitCommit.spec.mjs` is red without the fix ("did not settle within 5000 ms").
- `WorkstationStackReturnSplitNL.spec.mjs` is red 3/3 without the fix ("Request timed out").
- The full unit suite and CI's e2e job are green.

## Out of Scope

- #19583: the close path and identity of re-opened windows. It gets re-measured on the fixed engine.
- Native-return adoption of a single-item vessel (Mnemosyne's third note on #19583).
- `VdomLifecycle` merge semantics.
